description: Vyhľadá zverejnené inzeráty na BotMarket.sk (pozemky a komerčné nehnuteľnosti, Košice a východné Slovensko). Search published BotMarket.sk listings (land and commercial real estate, Košice and eastern Slovakia). Each result has the full listing (BotMarket listing v1 JSON schema) and its public_url. Structured fields: price (amount, per_m2, per_m2_min/max, vat), area, utilities, access, zoning, availability, updated_at; unknown values are null. Prices are in EUR; listings without a total price have price.amount=null and are skipped when price filters are used. No API key needed.

location.description: Obec, okres alebo adresa, napr. 'Mokrance' alebo 'Košice - okolie'.
